prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a parking lot collision in Pearland, Texas, and has neck and back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1086; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thanks for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the parking lot collision you reported. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather just keep it to the accident details, if that's okay.

Q: That's fine, we can leave your name off the transcript. Can you describe where the collision happened?

A: It was in a parking lot at a shopping center in Pearland. I was backing out of a space near the main entrance.

Q: Were you moving when the impact occurred?

A: Yes, I was going slowly, maybe two or three miles an hour. I had checked my mirror, but a pickup was coming down the aisle faster than I expected and clipped the rear quarter panel of my car.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle before contact?

A: Not really. I saw something white out of the corner of my eye, then I felt the jolt.

Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt?

A: Yes, I always do.

Q: Did you feel any injuries at the scene?

A: Not right away. I felt stiff in the neck, and by that evening my lower back was really sore. I've been seeing my doctor for it since.

Q: Has a doctor diagnosed you with anything?

A: They said it's a strain, both in the neck and the lower back. I've been doing physical therapy twice a week and taking muscle relaxers when it gets bad.

Q: Have you missed any work because of the injuries?

A: A few shifts, yes. I've been trying to push through, but lifting and sitting for long periods is hard.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add?

A: Just that I'm cooperating fully and I want this handled fairly for everyone involved.

Q: Thank you. That concludes the statement.
